summary: Wrote a 6-phase implementation plan for propagating the modified_files repo-relative-paths constraint. Phase 1 authors a canonical fragment under context/contracts/ plus its index entry; Phases 2-4 insert the two canonical literal lines and the metadata JSON key into 13 implementation agents (the 10 the dispatch named, plus 3 hard-mode agents whose filenames the dispatch's glob structurally could not match); Phase 5 adds lint-agent-contracts.sh Check L with fixture coverage as one atomic batch; Phase 6 redeploys and runs the full gate set. Verification rests on the static lint plus its fixture suite, since no per-agent runtime harness exists for prompt files.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: canonical fragment, 13-agent propagation, Check L plus fixtures, redeploy and full gate set.
